description: Customer purchase orders from the online bookstore.
grain: One row per order line item
notes: Amounts are in USD. Use single quotes for string filters. Join to books via book_id. The DuckDB table name must match "table" exactly.

order_id.description: Unique id for the order line

book_id.description: Foreign key to the books table

order_date.description: Calendar date the order was placed (DATE, not year integer)

price.description: Line-item price paid by the customer

relationships.description: Each order line references one book

exampleQuestions: Average price of orders for Harry Potter books
